def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    marker_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if any(v in (2, 8) for v in row)]
    if not marker_rows:
        return out
    r = marker_rows[-1]
    cols = [c for c, v in enumerate(grid[r]) if v in (2, 8)]
    for i, c in enumerate(cols):
        next_col = cols[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(cols) else len(grid[r]) - 1
        height = next_col - c
        top = r - height
        if top < 0:
            continue
        out[top][c] = grid[r][c]
        for rr in range(top + 1, r):
            out[rr][c] = 1
    return out
